parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, no documented police or state targeting of trans people, and no universal facility restriction — Pride runs annually with tens of thousands, gay venues operate, and prison data shows no recorded assaults on trans inmates. A 2021 survey documents moderate social acceptance (80% work, 75% friendship, 58% family). Weights against: media regulation grouping homosexuality with paedophilia, LGBTI org registration ban, toilet-backlash friction, no statutory gender-identity protection, and surgical-gated recognition (mostly resident-facing). Border treatment of mismatched documents and custody placement are open questions, not exposures. No documented visitor-facing service discrimination or violence. Net: functioning society with real but imperfect acceptance, no known traveller-facing restriction, unresolved edge cases — Reduced Risk, upper-middle.
